  syntax KItem ::= "#loop"

  syntax Bool ::= hasBreak(Stmt)              [function, total]
  rule hasBreak(𐕂 ;) => true
  rule hasBreak({ S:Stmt }) => hasBreak(S)
  rule hasBreak(S1:Stmt S2:Stmt) => hasBreak(S1) orBool hasBreak(S2)
  rule hasBreak(𐔼 (_) B1:Block 𐔽 B2:Block) => hasBreak(B1) orBool hasBreak(B2)
  rule hasBreak(_) => false                                      [owise]

  rule 𐔾 (B) S => 𐔼 (B) {S 𐔾 (B) S} 𐔽 {}

  rule <k> 𐔾 (B) S => 𐔼 (B) {S 𐔾 (B) S} 𐔽 {} ~> #loop ...</k>

  rule <k> 𐕂 ; ~> (_:Stmt => .K) ...</k>                [label(break_skip)]
